newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander benefits from Latam earnings.
newsitem.headline: Santander benefits from Latam earnings.

text.p: Spain's largest bank, Santander Group, said on Tuesday that 40 percent of its net attributable profit was drawn from Latin America.
Santander posted total first-half net attributable profit of 59.78 billion pesetas, up 30.2 percent over the year-ago period.

"Excluding goodwill amortization, and the financial costs associated with these investments, the combined contribution of retail banking and Santander Investment from this region came to 22.52 billion pesetas...well in line with the estimated income of $400 million for the full year," Santander said in its report to shareholders.
In a briefing with journalists, Santander added that this was about 40 percent of earnings.
